title: Amazon - Marketing Manager And Graphic Designer
description:
Overview

Marketing Manager and Graphic Designer - Amazon

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $ per month

About the Role :

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

About the Company :

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion
  • Translate skincare benefits, ingredients, and brand positioning into clear, premium visual narratives
  • Collaborate with marketing to align on USPs, target audiences, and creative direction; contribute thoughtful feedback and recommendations
  • Create infographics, lifestyle imagery, and visual instructions using provided photography and assets
  • Maintain strict adherence to Amazon image guidelines and evolving beauty / skincare creative trends
  • Organize files, templates, and versioning to support rapid testing and iteration

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing images (beauty / skincare preferred), with a strong portfolio of relevant work
  • Deep understanding of skincare and how to visually communicate ingredient benefits and product features
  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines
  • Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Storefront design
  • Comfortable collaborating, giving / receiving constructive feedback, and backing creative opinions with data and rationale
  • Tools : Adobe Photoshop; Google Sheets; familiarity with Amazon A+ Content modules and Seller tools
  • Advanced fluency in English is required (written and verbal)

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with packaging design and / or 3D mockup tools (e.g., Adobe Dimension, Blender)
  • Basic copywriting and understanding of marketing psychology for conversion-focused messaging
  • Experience leveraging ChatGPT to streamline creative workflows and project management
  • Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout systems and component libraries
  • Photo retouching and light color-grading for skincare / lifestyle imagery

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

How to Apply

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here’s what to expect :

  • Complete the application form (you’ll be sent the link after expressing interest)
  • Screening interview with our recruitment team
  • Interview with the client
  • Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made

We’re looking forward to learning more about you!

Job Type : Full-time

Application Question(s)

  • If we must fill this position urgently. Can you start immediately?
  • In case we need to fill the vacancy in 2 weeks or 1 month would you be able to wait?
  • Can you work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment?
  • Are you available for regular client review meetings and internal status calls?
  • Do you agree with the proposed salary in the Job post for a full time based job and monthly?
  • Are you comfortable working in a remote setting?
  • Are you willing to undergo a background check, in accordance with local law / regulations?
  • This is an independent contractor type of hiring. If you want to proceed please choose yes.
  • How many years of experience do you have designing Amazon listing images?
  • Have you previously designed visuals for beauty or skincare products?
  • Are you proficient in Adobe Photoshop?
  • Do you have experience creating Amazon A+ Content and Storefront designs?
  • Are you familiar with Amazon’s image guidelines for product listings?
  • Are you familiar with Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout and component libraries?

Language

  • english (Required)

title: Supply Chain Solutions Expert
description:
The Solution Expert’s mission is to manage the consistency between the business practices & processes for his/her domain and the underlying IT solutions. The Solution Expert assesses any new business needs requiring IT solution development and evolution, manages the realization of the functional requirements and validates the requested development, before user acceptance. This person is an expert within the Supply Chain business areas (Planning, Inventory, Manufacturing and Distribution) and works closely with the business owners to assist in business technology strategic development, solution discovery, and service management. This person serves as the functional point of contact for the Supply Chain business area and is the link to the various IT resources needed for successful implementation of business needs.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with each business line in the definition of business requirements and ensure scope of work and business cases are clearly defined within their projects.
  • Assists the business users and the technical support team in application support for critical issues.
  • Acts as the liaison between business users, PMO, and IT technical teams.
  • Ensure that IT resources (people, costs, systems, hardware) are aligned with business needs.
  • Create shared vision of their respective solutions and facilitate decision making and arbitration relating to trade-offs both within and between different solution platforms
  • Drive IT innovation, best practices, and cost efficiencies to improve the financial and operational performance of the business operations
  • Documents the functional designs for all enhancements and projects.
  • Works with the technical teams in the execution and design of application enhancements and digital projects.
  • Prioritize and delegate tasks and responsibilities to appropriate IT personnel as needed
  • Assists in the execution of the Digital and IT roadmap.
  • Process improvement: Works with his/her team as well as with cross-functional teams to continuously improve work processes. Continuously analyze the functioning of the activity, identifies causes of dysfunctions and proposes corrective measures accordingly.
  • Maintains an excellent relationship with key business stakeholders.
  • Assist the users (customers) in acceptance testing, developing procedures, and updating documentation.
  • Empower all users by creating a community of practice.

Requirements:

Education, Training or Certification Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or a related discipline
  • 8+ years experience in two of the three areas: Business/Operations, IT, or Project Management.
  • Strong knowledge of Supply Chain, Asset Management and Manufacturing processes and applications.
  • Experience with Oracle and SAP ERP systems

General Requirements and Knowledge:

  • Ability to speak English (a must), Spanish and possibly Portuguese would be preferable.
  • Customer-oriented and service-driven: Precisely answers customer requests, is attentive to customers, respects commitments towards customers and initiates new ideas in order to meet customer expectations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills: Gets to know others and forms relationships, maintains very good relationships with colleagues, respects the ideas and opinions of others.
  • Team Player: Shares knowledge and experience, cooperates and makes self available, listens, gathers information, takes into consideration the needs, ideas, opinions of others.
  • Problem-Solving: Identifies problem situations within an appropriate time frame, develops several alternative solutions to problems, analyzes situations and highlights important issues, suggests adequate, valuable and feasible solutions.
  • Decision-making skills: Considers all factors before making a decision, makes quick decisions when necessary and accepts the consequences and risks involved.
  • Technical Abilities: Masters concepts, tools and methods related to his/her job, meets or exceeds professional requirements of his/her field of work, keeps abreast of progress in his/her field.
  • Initiative: Initiates actions, ideas or solutions spontaneously on his own, undertakes action without waiting for directives, uses all of his/her resources before asking for help, establishes his/her performance objectives and deadlines.
  • Ability to achieve consensus between stakeholders with divergent interests
  • Ability to understand and translate business requirements into technical requirements and vice versa
  • Demonstrated experience in managing projects

Why build your career at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.

What are our values?

  • We are people serving people
  • We all think and act like owners
  • We are hungry for performance
  • We grow and learn together
  • We pursue excellence and simplicity
  • We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

Job Title: B2B Kitchen Cabinet Sales Specialist

Full-time - 40 hours / week; US hours

Company: Our client’s company is a growing e-commerce company specializing in high-quality kitchen and bathroom cabinetry. They are expanding their B2B services and are looking for an experienced Kitchen Cabinet Designer & Sales Specialist to join their team. In this role, you will also support an additional in-house home product brand focused on modern, design-oriented residential solutions. Training and product knowledge will be provided.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Acquisition & Relationship Management: Proactively reach out to builders, contractors, interior designers, and other B2B clients. Build strong, long-term business partnerships.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of B2B sales or design experience in the kitchen / cabinetry industry (4+ years strongly preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of cabinetry specifications, commercial design, and construction drawings.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Proficiency with design tools such as 20-20 Design and / or AutoCAD.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Pipedrive preferred) and digital communication tools (WhatsApp, Dialpad).
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and client relationship skills.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and able to thrive in a remote team environment.
  • Spanish fluency preferred; English proficiency required.
  • Experience with e-commerce is a plus.

Benefits

  • Base + Uncapped commission structure + performance bonuses
  • Flexible full-time working hours
  • Professional development and growth opportunities
  • Supportive, collaborative remote environment
  • Payments are in USD.

Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

title: Seo Strategist / Head Of Seo
description:
Overview


We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary SEO Strategist / Head of SEO to define and lead our search growth roadmap. In this senior role, you will be responsible for setting the overall SEO direction, prioritizing initiatives that drive business impact, and aligning organic growth efforts with company-wide objectives.


As a T-shaped marketer, you will combine deep SEO expertise with a broad understanding of marketing, analytics, and digital growth. You will work closely with leadership, product, design, content, and development teams to ensure SEO is embedded across every function of the business. The ideal candidate is both analytical and creative, capable of developing data-driven strategies while inspiring cross-functional teams to execute at the highest level.



Responsibilities



  • Strategy & Leadership

    • Define the organization’s SEO vision, long-term growth roadmap, and execution strategy.

    • Design and implement comprehensive SEO initiatives across technical SEO, content strategy, link-building, and experimentation.

    • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on ROI, complexity, and competitive landscape.

    • Align SEO objectives with overarching business KPIs, including marketing qualified leads (MQLs), customer acquisition cost (CAC), annual recurring revenue (ARR), and pipeline velocity.

    • Continuously monitor search engine trends, algorithm updates, and industry best practices to maintain a competitive advantage.

    • Champion SEO within the organization, ensuring buy-in from stakeholders and visibility at the leadership level.



  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Partner with product and development teams to ensure SEO requirements are factored into platform architecture, site migrations, and new feature rollouts.

    • Work with content and editorial teams to build a scalable framework for keyword-driven, high-performing content.

    • Collaborate with design and UX / UI teams to ensure website changes and new templates support both usability and SEO performance.

    • Align closely with marketing and demand generation teams to integrate SEO into campaigns, events, and broader growth initiatives.

    • Build strong relationships across departments to foster a culture where SEO is considered a critical growth lever, not a siloed function.



  • Performance Tracking & Reporting

    • Establish a robust measurement framework for SEO, defining clear KPIs and success benchmarks.

    • Use analytics tools (GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Looker Studio) to monitor performance, identify opportunities, and track progress.

    • Deliver detailed reporting to leadership on keyword growth, traffic trends, conversion impact, and revenue attribution from SEO.

    • Translate complex SEO data into actionable insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

    • Identify gaps in analytics or reporting and collaborate with data teams to enhance measurement accuracy.



  • Team & Vendor Management

    • Build and lead an SEO team (in-house or distributed), ensuring a balance of technical expertise, content strategy, and off-page authority building.

    • Manage external SEO agencies, freelancers, or consultants, ensuring alignment with internal goals and quality standards.

    • Mentor and upskill team members across departments, fostering greater SEO literacy throughout the organization.





Qualifications



  • Must-Haves

    • 4+ years of proven SEO strategy and leadership experience, ideally in a tech-driven environment.

    • Demonstrated track record of scaling organic channels to deliver measurable business results (e.g., revenue growth, lead generation, or market expansion).

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and make data-driven decisions.

    • Proficiency in SEO and analytics platforms, including GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, and Looker Studio.

    • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executives and cross-functional peers.

    • Deep understanding of how SEO intersects with broader marketing, product, and sales strategies.



  • Nice-to-Haves

    • Experience managing SEO at scale for international or enterprise-level websites.

    • Familiarity with CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), paid media, and marketing automation tools.

    • Hands-on experience with technical SEO concepts such as schema markup, JavaScript rendering, and Core Web Vitals.

    • Background in leading distributed teams or managing agency partnerships.





Why Join Us?


This is a rare opportunity to take ownership of a mission-critical growth channel at a pivotal stage in our company’s expansion. As Head of SEO, you will shape not only our search performance but also how SEO informs and strengthens the broader go-to-market strategy. You will be empowered to make high-level decisions, experiment with innovative approaches, and directly impact the scalability of our business.

We are seeking a motivated and detail oriented Inside Sales Specialist to join our Life Sciences sales team. This role is critical in driving revenue growth across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio of pre-clinical and translational oncology services, including organoids, in vivo and in vitro models, biomarker discovery, human biospecimens, and integrated drug discovery solutions.

The Inside Sales Specialist will develop strong client relationships, manage the inside sales cycle, and support business development initiatives with biotech, pharma, and academic researchers worldwide. By promoting Crown Bioscience's world-leading preclinical platforms, cancer databases, and precision oncology offerings, this role ensures scientists have the tools they need to accelerate discoveries in cancer diagnostics and therapeutics.

Importantly, the Inside Sales Specialist will work with Prendio, a third-party procurement platform for the biotech industry, to help generate biotech leads, manage referrals from their preferred supplier network, and strengthen the partnership relationship.

  • Sales & Business Development
    • Proactively identify, qualify, and manage inbound and outbound sales opportunities across Crown Bioscience's full portfolio (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, human biospecimens, etc.).

    • Collaborate with SDRs and field-based Business Development Directors to support client acquisition, account expansion, and long-term growth.
    • Serve as the primary inside sales contact for Prendio-generated biotech leads.
    • Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets, contributing directly to company revenue goals.
  • Customer Engagement
    • Serve as the first point of contact for researchers, biotech, pharma, and CRO clients seeking preclinical and translational oncology solutions.
    • Build strong, trust-based relationships by understanding client needs and recommending tailored Crown Bioscience offerings.
    • Deliver accurate and timely information regarding service capabilities, project feasibility, and proposal details.
    • Provide outstanding customer service throughout the sales cycle, ensuring client satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Operational & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with operations, scientific, and project management teams to ensure feasibility, accuracy, and timely delivery of client projects.
    • Maintain detailed records of client interactions, pipeline activity, and forecasts within the CRM system.
    • Share market and customer feedback with internal stakeholders to help refine and expand service offerings.
    • Collaborate closely with external partners like Prendio to maximize lead generation opportunities and strengthen biotech outreach.

Minimum Requirements

  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.

  • Highly organized with attention to detail and experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Self-motivated team player with a proactive approach and passion for supporting oncology research.

Preferred Requirements

  • Advanced degree (MSc, MBA, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field.
  • 3+ years of inside sales or business development experience in oncology or precision medicine services.
  • Strong understanding of preclinical workflows (organoids, in vivo/in vitro models, biomarkers, biospecimens).
  • Experience working with or managing leads from third-party platforms (e.g., procurement networks such as Prendio).
  • Background in supporting biotech, pharma, or CRO clients with complex research needs.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment Type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master’s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts, e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles.

Required Qualifications

Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the worlds biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Location

Remote

Employment Type

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Masters or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts, e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles.

Required Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • English language assessment is required as part of the project (mandatory and non-billable).

title: Chemistry Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ : INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML / AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Chemistry Subject Matter Expert (SME) to contribute to the development and training of AI Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Chemistry SME, you will play a critical role in guiding AI models to understand complex chemistry concepts, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and contextual understanding in the domain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to train, refine, and evaluate Large Language Models with a focus on Chemistry content.
  • Develop high-quality, accurate, and domain-specific datasets, including conceptual explanations, technical documents, research abstracts, and problem-solving content.
  • Review and validate AI-generated content for technical accuracy, clarity, and contextual relevance in the field of Chemistry.
  • Provide expert feedback on model outputs, identify conceptual gaps, and suggest improvements to enhance model learning.
  • Assist in creating and annotating training datasets, including classification, tagging, and contextual labeling of chemistry-related data.
  • Ensure all content meets scientific rigor and is aligned with industry best practices.
  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Chemistry and AI to continuously improve training methodologies.

Key Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific field.
  • Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of chemistry concepts (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical, Biochemistry, etc.).
  • Prior experience in academic research, technical writing, or teaching is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with data annotation, content development, or training AI models is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for accuracy and scientific precision.

Technical Skills (Preferred)

  • Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Experience using annotation tools or content management platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of Python or data handling tools (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Understanding of data quality control processes.

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

The assessment is mandatory & non-billable

description:
Overview

The Mosaic Company (NYSE: MOS) is the world's leading integrated producer of concentrated phosphate and potash — two of the three most important nutrients in agriculture. We employ more than 13,000 people in six countries to serve farmers around the world. Our headquarters are in Lithia, Florida with operations throughout North America (U.S./Canada) and South America.

At Mosaic We Help the World Grow the Food it Needs - Apply today and join our team!

This position is a virtual role covering southern Wisconsin and northern Illinois.

What will you do?

  • Develop and execute annual Bioscience and Performance Product Sales growth targets and marketing plans for the assigned territory. Evaluate opportunities for growth and manage the customer distribution strategy. Collaborate with Account Managers, Key Account Managers, Product Line, Agronomy, Marketing and other functions to determine the go-to-market model by region and to develop a value proposition based on current customer segmentation, market trends, and strategy.
  • Coordinate with Sales Leadership, Agronomy and Crop Nutrition Leads to develop a consistent agronomic positioning of Mosaic products. Assist with the development of training materials and internal Train-the-Trainer programs related to the portfolio, including creating a business case for retailer support, portfolio alignment with Mosaic products, agronomic knowledge of advanced crop nutrition, and positioning the value of biological products for retailers and farmers.
  • Develop an annual calendar of promotional and training activities by customer within the sales territory. Organize and participate in technical and promotional events and Mosaic conferences/forums. Support and develop promotional materials and campaigns by customer/region. Work with account managers to create weekly product analyses, budgets, forecasts and ensure data transfer to the sales team and other functions.
  • Take an active role in peer mentoring, assist assigned Retail Sales Advisors, provide team leadership in team meetings, and support other special projects.

What do you need for this role?

  • Bachelor's Degree required, major in Agribusiness, Marketing, Agronomy, Soil Science or related field
  • 5–7 years of high-level sales and/or marketing experience
  • Strong background with proprietary products or technology-driven markets (traits, specialized agronomic products/services). Strong agronomic understanding. Retail experience or broad understanding of retail trends and business operations
  • Exceptional customer relationship skills and ability to develop trust through listening and responsiveness
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including excellent presentation and training skills
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent team-building and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently
  • Ability to adapt to a continually changing business and work environment, and manage multiple priorities
  • Results-oriented
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
  • Certified Crop Advisor (CCA) preferred

What's in it for you

  • A competitive base salary + bonus incentives
  • 11 paid holidays each year
  • A generous 401(k) with company match and annual contributions
  • Paid sick leave
  • Paid vacation time
  • Robust benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision, life & disability)
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Paid paternity/maternity leave

Break down complex concepts into smaller and more digestible components that allow for a greater level of understanding by others.

Matrix Medical Network offers a broad range of clinical services and proven expertise that give primary care providers and the at-risk health plan members we visit with every day the tools and knowledge to better manage their health at home. During a visit that can last up to one hour, Matrix providers review and observe a member’s current health, medical history, medication adherence, social environment and other risks. The Matrix Comprehensive Health Assessment helps to improve quality of care and allows us to potentially close multiple care gaps with a single visit.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Soluções, Startup
description:
Você gosta de startups? Tem interesse em computação em nuvem? Temos uma posição para você.
As startups são as grandes empresas do futuro. Estas jovens empresas são fundadas por pessoas ambiciosas que desejam construir algo significativo e desafiar o status quo seja para atender novos clientes ou para desafiar os atuais. Geralmente operam em um ambiente de escassez: seja de capital, recursos de engenharia ou experiência. É aqui que você entra.
A equipe de arquitetura de soluções de inicialização da AWS se dedica a trabalhar com essas empresas que estão em estágio inicial à medida que elas constroem seus negócios. Estamos aqui para garantir que eles possam implantar as melhores, mais escaláveis e mais seguras arquiteturas possíveis – e que gastem o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso.
Procuramos construtoras técnicas que amam a ideia de trabalhar com startups em estágio inicial para ajudá-las à medida que crescem. Nesta função, você trabalhará diretamente com clientes interessantes e os ajudará a tomar as melhores (e às vezes mais pragmáticas) decisões técnicas ao longo do caminho. Você terá a oportunidade de construir relacionamentos duradouros com essas empresas e se estabelecer como um consultor confiável.
Temos mais de 200 serviços em diversas categorias diferentes e é importante que possamos ajudar as startups a aproveitar as vantagens dos serviços certos. Você também desempenhará um papel importante como defensora de nossas equipes de produtos para garantir que estamos construindo os produtos certos para as startups com as quais você trabalha. E para os clientes com os quais você não trabalha individualmente, terá a oportunidade de compartilhar seu conhecimento de forma mais ampla, trabalhando em conteúdo técnico e apresentando-se em eventos.

Key job responsibilities
- Envolver-se diretamente com pessoas clientes iniciantes para fornecer-lhes apoio técnico à medida que constroem seus produtos na nuvem. Certifique-se de que eles estão gastando o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso;
- Criar planos, em conjunto com outros membros das equipes de contas do cliente, para definir como você ajudará as pessoas clientes com suas necessidades de nuvem;
- Compartilhar amplamente seu conhecimento técnico participando de sessões selecionadas, focadas em startups, com uma pessoa e em grupos maiores de clientes;
- Trabalhar com outras equipes na AWS (por exemplo, marketing, treinamento) para contribuir para a criação de conteúdo que possa ser entregue à comunidade mais ampla de startups em escala (por exemplo, vídeos on-line e outros conteúdos digitais).
A day in the life
Como membro do líder mundial para este espaço empolgante e de crescimento rápido, você terá a oportunidade de ajudar a impulsionar o crescimento e moldar o futuro de uma categoria de serviço que terá um impacto significativo em nossos clientes de modelo global de computação. This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

title: Senior Analytics Engineer – Dbt Core
description:
Overview

Já pensou em se tornar um Roxpert e trabalhar na empresa que ficou no 66º lugar entre as 1212 pequenas melhores para se trabalhar ranqueadas pelo GPTW? A Rox Partner é uma empresa jovem, focada em dados, em rápido crescimento como consultoria. Com quase 6 anos anos no mercado já contamos com mais de 160 colaboradores, ótimos clientes, parceiros e inúmeros desafios! E aí, bora evoluir juntos?

Estamos em plena expansão e buscamos profissionais motivados que anseiem integrar-se a uma empolgante jornada rumo à excelência em dados. Esta é uma vaga de Senior Analytics Engineer – DBT Core.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar como referência técnica em projetos de engenharia de dados e BI / Analytics, liderando iniciativas de modelagem, transformação e disponibilização de dados.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir pipelines de dados utilizando DBT Core, assegurando boas práticas no uso de macros, templates, tagueamentos e catálogo de dados.
  • Conduzir a orquestração ponta a ponta dos fluxos de dados, desde a ingestão até a camada analítica, garantindo performance, governança e confiabilidade.
  • Apoiar as áreas de negócio no desenho de soluções analíticas, traduzindo necessidades em modelos de dados eficientes.
  • Atuar na análise de processos AS-IS e propor refatorações e melhorias contínuas em integrações e pipelines existentes.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo alinhamento entre engenharia, analytics e negócio.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e boas práticas para sustentar e escalar o ambiente de dados.

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Experiência avançada em DBT Core, incluindo uso de macros e templates, aplicação de tagueamentos, criação de documentação e catálogo de dados.
  • Experiência prática em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), com domínio em BigQuery, estruturas de dados, modelagem relacional e analítica, além de otimização de queries (SQL tuning).
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação, especialmente Python, para automações, desenvolvimento de scripts de integração e suporte a pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência em bancos de dados, com ênfase em Oracle, incluindo leitura e análise de processos legados.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ETL / ELT de mercado, preferencialmente Informatica Power Center, para entendimento, manutenção e refatoração de fluxos existentes.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de dados, incluindo versionamento de código com Git, implementação de testes automatizados, aplicação de práticas de governança e monitoramento de pipelines.

BENEFÍCIOS OFERECIDOS

  • Contrato PJ;
  • Atuação remota;
  • Vale Home Office (VR / VA) no valor de R$ 300 por mês cumulativos para gastar como, quando e onde quiser (o valor é creditado na sua conta do iFood mensalmente e temos o cartão bandeira elo);
  • Aniversário — Uma data tão especial, a Rox te presenteia com um vale presente e um day off para que você possa curtir seu dia!!;
  • Blog — Na Rox incentivamos o compartilhamento, caso queira publicar um artigo em nosso blog (a cada 2 posts aprovados) você ganha um dia de day off! : )
  • Cursos : Acesso compartilhado completo pelo Hotmart para Documentação de Projetos, Plataforma Alura, Cloud Guru, Oreilly para livros e palestras e Roxschool;
  • Certificações : Reembolso de certificação de até R$ 300,00 (AWS, AZURE, GCP, DATABRICKS, ELASTIC, CLOUDERA, ORACLE, MICROSOFT, MYSQL, OUTROS ) + Bônus de R$300,00 por certificação alcançada dessas Brands — Combinar o plano antes com o Gestor);
  • Auxílio Psicólogo : Duas sessões de Psicólogo custeado pela ROX durante o mês;
  • Parceria Feedz — Plataforma onde podemos estarmos mais próximos, melhorarmos a comunicação e acompanharmos como estamos em relação a sentimentos, engajamento, feedback e desempenho.
  • Gympass : Parceria com academias e aplicativos de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Oferecemos o equipamento de trabalho.

title: Amazon - Marketing Manager And Graphic Designer
description:
Overview

Marketing Manager and Graphic Designer - Amazon

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $ per month

About the Role

We’re seeking an Amazon Graphics Designer to craft premium, on-brand visuals that boost click-through and conversion for skincare products. You’ll transform product USPs and ingredient benefits into clean, conversion-oriented imagery across hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, and A+ content. This role is ideal for a designer who loves partnering with marketing, testing ideas, and pushing for the best creative outcomes.

About the Company

A growing beauty and skincare e-commerce brand focused on premium, science-informed products and exceptional customer experience on Amazon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing Amazon listing visuals (hero images, feature callouts, comparison charts, A+ content) optimized for CTR and conversion
  • Translate skincare benefits, ingredients, and brand positioning into clear, premium visual narratives
  • Collaborate with marketing to align on USPs, target audiences, and creative direction; contribute thoughtful feedback and recommendations
  • Create infographics, lifestyle imagery, and visual instructions using provided photography and assets
  • Maintain strict adherence to Amazon image guidelines and evolving beauty / skincare creative trends
  • Organize files, templates, and versioning to support rapid testing and iteration

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing images (beauty / skincare preferred), with a strong portfolio of relevant work
  • Deep understanding of skincare and how to visually communicate ingredient benefits and product features
  • Advanced skills in typography, layout, and visual storytelling with meticulous attention to detail
  • Ability to turn raw product info into clean, conversion-focused visuals under tight deadlines
  • Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Storefront design
  • Comfortable collaborating, giving / receiving constructive feedback, and backing creative opinions with data and rationale
  • Tools: Adobe Photoshop; Google Sheets; familiarity with Amazon A+ Content modules and Seller tools
  • Advanced fluency in English is required (written and verbal)

Nice to Have Skills

  • Familiarity with packaging design and / or 3D mockup tools (e.g., Adobe Dimension, Blender)
  • Basic copywriting and understanding of marketing psychology for conversion-focused messaging
  • Experience leveraging ChatGPT to streamline creative workflows and project management
  • Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Figma for layout systems and component libraries
  • Photo retouching and light color-grading for skincare / lifestyle imagery

Why Join Us?

Work on beautiful, premium skincare brands where your creative decisions directly impact visibility and sales. Join a collaborative team that values thoughtful pushback, testing, and continuous learning—where you’re encouraged to teach, challenge assumptions, and help raise the bar on Amazon-first design.

How to Apply

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here’s what to expect :

  • Complete the application form (you’ll be sent the link after expressing interest)
  • Screening interview with our recruitment team
  • Interview with the client
  • Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made

We’re looking forward to learning more about you!

Job Type: Full-time

Application Question(s)

  • If we must fill this position urgently. Can you start immediately?
  • In case we need to fill the vacancy in 2 weeks or 1 month would you be able to wait?
  • Can you work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment?
  • Are you available for regular client review meetings and internal status calls?
  • Do you agree with the proposed salary in the Job post for a full time based job and monthly?
  • Are you comfortable working in a remote setting?
  • Are you willing to undergo a background check, in accordance with local law / regulations?
  • This is an independent contractor type of hiring. If you want to proceed please choose yes.
  • How many years of experience do you have designing Amazon listing images?
  • Have you previously designed visuals for beauty or skincare products?
  • Are you proficient in Adobe Photoshop?
  • Do you have experience creating Amazon A+ Content and Storefront designs?

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita na língua portuguesa e inglesa.
  • Bons conhecimentos de informática, como MS Office, softwares de CRM (Hubspot é um diferencial), redes sociais e agendas eletrônicas.

title: Analista de Operações de Marketplace
description:
Overview

O que é a nstech?

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Acreditamos no poder da tecnologia para melhorar o mundo, reduzindo a emissão de CO2, acidentes e roubos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Operações de Marketplace . Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Main responsibilities

  • Monitorar e otimizar o processo de onboarding de compradores e fornecedores, garantindo rampagem rápida e eficaz;
  • Acompanhar SLAs de atendimento e performance de uso da plataforma, atuando para corrigir desvios;
  • Suportar os processos de atendimento, faturamento, cobrança e conciliação de pedidos, minimizando erros;
  • Analisar indicadores críticos do marketplace, como: Taxa de resposta de fornecedores, tempo de fechamento de cotações, GMV e taxa de ativação e engajamento de clientes;
  • Gerar relatórios e análises para a liderança, sugerindo melhorias em processos e fluxos operacionais;
  • Atuar como referência técnica em operações, garantindo eficiência do time e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Participar de testes de novas funcionalidades e apoiar o time de produto;
  • Realizar atendimentos e treinamentos multidisciplinares para clientes e stakeholders;
  • Garantir integração e correta utilização de múltiplos sistemas no dia a dia.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Logística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em operações de marketplace, e-commerce ou SaaS;
  • Vivência em processos de onboarding, atendimento e billing/cobrança;
  • Experiência com análise de dados operacionais e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Excel (nível intermediário ou avançado);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CRM e atendimento (Moviedesk, HubSpot, Huawei ou similares).

Será um diferencial se:

  • Já tiver atuado na área de Compras, com conhecimento de fluxos de negociação e relacionamento com fornecedores.

Additional information

O que esperamos de você:

Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos pilares culturais e seus atributos são:

• Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética

• Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo

• Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados

Por que trabalhar na nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. Além disso:

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level : Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable): Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Overview

At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower fearless commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here.

Department: US Sales:

The North America Sales organization at Signifyd is dedicated to empowering e-commerce businesses to grow fearlessly by eliminating fraud, preventing chargebacks, and safeguarding their bottom line. Our primary focus is on driving new logo acquisition, partnering with online merchants across diverse industries—from leading enterprise retailers to rapidly growing e-commerce businesses—to maximize their revenue by approving more legitimate orders and significantly reducing the financial burden of fraud and consumer abuse.

We provide a cutting-edge Commerce Protection Platform that leverages advanced ML and our vast global Commerce Network to deliver real-time, guaranteed decisions on every transaction. To effectively penetrate and expand within the market, our team thrives on deep cross-functional collaboration. We work hand-in-hand with Solutions Engineering to craft bespoke demonstrations, Marketing for targeted outreach campaigns, Product for roadmap insights and deep-dives, and Customer Success to ensure seamless onboarding and long-term value for our new clients. This integrated approach is essential as we deliver unparalleled value and secure the trust of new merchants across North America.

The Role:

Signifyd is looking to expand the Enterprise Accounts team with the goal of establishing mutually beneficial partnerships with some of the largest and most admired brands in the world. We are looking for strategic thinkers and experienced sellers to attract, win, replicate, and deliver innovative business outcomes that continuously improve our own business while helping others grow theirs.

This is a senior position that extends beyond traditional transactional selling, requiring a consultative, strategic, and creative approach to build trusted advisor relationships across diverse enterprise organizations. It requires a proven track record balancing multiple client priorities, conveying value in ways that resonate across various stakeholders, and building a strong ecosystem of advocates - including C-suite decision makers, internally and externally.

In this role, you will collaborate with an Enterprise Account Executive to develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for your territory. You and your AE will be responsible for managing full sales cycles across the territory.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your Enterprise Account executive to develop and execute on the plan for your territory and account plans. You will be responsible for initiating the strategy and tagging in your AE to provide support on more complex deals.
  • Lead all aspects of a sales cycle from start to finish both internally and externally including: prospecting, discovery, Proof of Concepts, value proposition positioning and pricing, contract closing and successfully supporting customers through Go-Live
  • Serve as a credible SME for prospects, providing education, memorable engagements, compelling content, and thought leadership designed to provide value to prospects, create lasting relationships, and ultimately win new business.
  • Develop creative strategies and storytelling to drive engagement with prospects. Demonstrate ability to use data and insights to overcome objections and craft a compelling value-based solution across multiple shareholders.
  • Consistently update Salesforce (SFDC), leveraging this tool as the single source of truth on prospect accounts and opportunities. Capture timely and detailed call/meeting reports, articulating customer needs, deliverables, and next steps to ensure Partners and leadership team are aware of updates.
  • Accountable for driving pipeline, sales, revenue, and meeting or exceeding quota goals in the assigned vertical across the territory
  • Partner effectively with SE, CS, Product, Marketing, VE, RI, IM, and other teams to drive initiatives that support the needs of the prospect throughout the deal cycle.
  • Attend industry conferences, sponsored events, and on-sites in order to develop relationships with prospects and expand Signifyd’s network

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of direct field sales experience with a proven track record in developing new business across different verticals including large multi-divisional/multinational companies
  • Successful, established track record of business development experience, specifically with senior leadership and C-level executives, within Enterprise Sales
  • Experience selling $400K+ ACV deals
  • Self-starter who can demonstrate development, growth and expansion of a territory
  • Proven track record of effective outbound prospecting, managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles and accurate pipeline management and forecasting
  • Experience working cross functionally with sales engineering, data science, risk management, and customer success.

Overview

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager’s primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest’s key accounts and growth opportunities. We are looking for a forward-thinking, meticulously organized, and self-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast-paced environment. This role requires someone who is proactive, creative, and can exercise their own discretion and judgment to create their own solutions when needed.

  • Travel - Ability to be in the field 3 days/week

Human Interest is tackling one of our country\'s biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You\'ll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team\'s contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. The specific pay rate offered is based on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Location

Remote

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master’s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Competencies

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level : Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms, real-time presence, audio / video (WebRTC), chat, screen sharing, collaborative boards, and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope / out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to WebRTC / A / V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Rare Disease Specialist

About Soleno Therapeutics Inc

Soleno is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of novel therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases based in Redwood City, CA.

At Soleno, we are driven by the unique and multi-faceted needs of the PWS community. Like these individuals, resilience is part of who we are - it is in our chromosomes - and our team is made up of exceptional colleagues whose collective efforts are woven together to deliver meaningful outcomes, both professionally and for those living with PWS.

We value collaboration, integrity, and respect. These characteristics have allowed us to forge strong, authentic bonds with the caregivers, patients, health care professionals (HCPs) and community members we serve. We are proud to work alongside them every step of the way.

Our employees are our greatest asset, and we\'re expanding across functions during this pivotal time. We invite you to join us in making an impact-and making history. We all share the most important goal of bringing solutions to the PWS community.

Summary of Job (brief description)

The Rare Disease Specialist role at Soleno will drive the commercial launch and sales initiatives of Soleno\'s leading product candidate, DCCR, for the treatment of Prader-Willi syndrome (PWS). You will engage with healthcare professionals at multiple points-of-call and be a familiar and compassionate resource to caregivers and families managing the complex challenges of PWS, building trust and long-term relationships while providing education on Soleno\'s therapies. By understanding the unique physical, emotional, and psychological difficulties faced by PWS patients and their caregivers, you\'ll play a crucial role in supporting their care with empathy and dedication.

Responsibilities

  • Engage a well-defined pool of caregivers and medical specialists to build market development, raise brand awareness, and execute a territory strategy/account plan with precision, ensuring product success through launch and beyond.
  • Develop a post-launch territory strategy that is rooted in nurturing existing relationships and raising awareness.
  • Conduct regular field visits to ensure effective communication and address any issues that arise.
  • Engage providers and drive awareness across multiple points of call, including to specialists in neurology, endocrinology, and psychiatry.
  • Work to ensure that new and existing patients are identified and enrolled in treatment programs.
  • Segment clinics and identify key shareholders within target institutions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, office staff, caregivers, and families. Gather insights and conduct post-call analysis to refine tactics based on the unique territory challenges and dynamics of the rare disease market.
  • Demonstrate a high level of emotional intelligence to adapt communication styles to fit the unique demands of HCPs and advocacy groups within the PWS community.
  • Routinely monitor and report on territory-level market dynamics and trends, including prescriber opinion, competitive activity, and developments in the PWS landscape.
  • Regularly report sales activities, performance metrics, and competitive insights to sales management.
  • Proactively foster effective working relationships with internal/external stakeholders at Soleno Therapeutics and drive agreement/decisions from multiple parties.
  • Collaborate across all commercial departments, including Patient Services, Medical Affairs, and others, ensuring alignment with external stakeholders in the rare disease space.
  • Participate in the development of sales strategies to meet quarterly and annual targets by tailoring tactics to address specific territory challenges.
  • Effectively prioritize and manage time, activities, and resources to engage with a network of healthcare professionals specializing in rare diseases.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations during all sales activities.
  • Maintain a positive and collaborative culture that aligns with the overall sales organization.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of PWS and the healthcare landscape to support customer needs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree is required, advanced degree preferred.
  • A background in nursing, social worker, nutrition (as a registered dietitian), or a related field with rare disease experience is a plus.
  • At least 5-7 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry with a proven track record in sales.
  • Previous launch experience highly preferred.
  • Prior experience in rare genetic disease or specialty sales is highly preferred.
  • A drive to serve the PWS community and a demonstrated compassionate approach to patient care and provider awareness.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and influence skills.
  • Ability to travel 60% of the time.
  • Compliance and regulatory training background preferred.

Salary Range: $185,000-$205,000

(Actual salary at the time of hire may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate\'s relevant qualifications, skills, and experience, as well as the location where this position may be filled.)

description:
Overview

Como a maior empresa de Educação Básica do Brasil, nos cercamos de pessoas excepcionais, entusiasmadas e comprometidas com a missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil por meio da educação.

Buscamos ser a referência no mundo em tecnologia para educação! Para isso, procuramos pessoas antenadas e apaixonadas por desenvolvimento de software, ávidas por conhecimento, que gostem de inovar, e que sejam proativas e criativas na busca das melhores soluções para nossas escolas, alunos, professores e funcionários.

Na função de Tech Lead de uma de nossas Squads, esperamos que você possua uma forte bagagem técnica e perfil colaborativo, capaz de treinar e liderar, influenciar decisões técnicas e de negócio, e contribuir ativamente para o desenvolvimento profissional do time.

Responsibilities and Assignments

Sua missão será :

  • Liderar o time técnico – Desenvolvedores, QAs e Suporte Técnico – de uma Squad, garantindo uma cultura de excelência de entrega em termos de prazos e qualidade;
  • Atuar com maestria em todo ciclo de vida de um projeto de software: entendimento das necessidades de negócio, refinamentos técnicos, definição de arquitetura, delivery, testes automatizados, integração contínua, deploy contínuo;

  • Conduzir revisões de código, promover a evolução contínua da arquitetura e garantir a manutenção de padrões organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente de rituais, workshops, reuniões de alinhamento e momentos de formação técnica com o time;

  • Transmitir seus conhecimentos para o time de forma constante, contribuindo para o crescimento técnico de toda equipe.

Requirements and Qualifications

Para assumir esse desafio, você precisa ter :

  • Experiência de no mínimo 3 anos liderando times de desenvolvimento;
  • Que seja uma yes-person, sempre encarando os desafios com otimismo;
  • Que seja incansável na busca da alta performance da equipe, tanto em termos de compromissos / prazos quanto em termos de qualidade de excelência;
  • Vasta experiência em desenvolvimento, especificamente com HTML / CSS / Javascript, .NET, Angular.
  • Domínio das melhores práticas em qualidade de desenvolvimento, especificamente Design Patterns, S.O.L.I.D e Testes Unitários / API / Automatizados;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, performance e estratégias de uso;
  • Experiência com DevOps, Continuous Delivery Pipeline (CI, CD, Containers, Dynamic Environment Configuration);
  • Experiência no uso de alguma ferramenta de IA (ex. Cursor, Github Copilot).

Além disso, será considerado como diferencial :

  • Experiência com observabilidade (ex. Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana, etc);
  • Terraform / Docker;
  • Já tenha trabalhado com nuvens públicas (AWS, Azure, etc.);
  • Experiência com Microserviços.

E esperamos que você coloque em prática algumas características :

  • Seja antenado e apaixonado por desenvolvimento de software;
  • Seja Ávido por conhecimento;
  • Tenha proatividade;
  • Trabalhe bem equipe, que goste de aprender, ensinar e ajudar o time;
  • Seja cuidadoso com excelência e qualidade;
  • Seja resiliente.

Additional Information

Carga horária : 44 horas semanais.

Localidade: a empresa é em Botafogo - Rio de Janeiro (RJ), mas o trabalho é 100% remoto.

Nós oferecemos : Vale-Refeição; Vale-Transporte; Trabalho Remoto; Auxílio Home Office; Direito a receber um reembolso de até R$400,00 referente à compra de uma cadeira ergonômica, visando beneficiar o trabalho remoto; Assistência médica e odontológica SulAmérica (com co-participação); Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Day off no mês do aniversário; Ambiente Salta de Aprendizagem : Cursos gratuitos sobre liderança e comunicação que vão alavancar sua carreira!; Parcerias no Salta +Benefícios : T.T Burguer, Chefs Club, PrimePass, Magalu, NetShoes, Ponto Frio, Casas Bahia, Cultura Inglesa, CNA, Ibmec, Le Canton, BodyTech, Budda Spa, entre vários outros!; Seu filho(a) tem direito a bolsa escolar (consulte a equipe de Gente e Gestão para verificar as regras).

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

CONHEÇA O GRUPO SALTA EDUCAÇÃO

Somos o maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil e temos a missão de construir um país melhor para as próximas gerações. Quer saber como fazemos isso?

Acreditamos que o ensino de qualidade pode ser um modelo sustentável para impactar crianças e jovens em todo o país. E esse desafio nos move diariamente.

Para realizar esse sonho, contamos com um time inovador e criativo, cheio de energia e, principalmente, apaixonado pelo que faz. O nosso DNA é marcado pela cultura de excelência, impacto social, desenvolvimento pessoal e espírito realizador.

Também levamos a inclusão a sério, pensando em processos de reconhecimento justos e éticos, além de contarmos com grupos de afinidade racial, LGBTQIA+, de pessoas com deficiência e de gênero.
